name: Jett Dawson
source:
Being both the hottest and fastest Drag Racer in the country has made Jett an icon in competitive racing. But after an accident just over a year ago left him burned and scarred, he decided to take a break from competing while he healed. The public has not seen his face since then, and mystery surrounds him wherever he goes. But he promises, once his body fully heals, that he'll get right back into the action with all the same fiery passion and enthusiasm that he has today.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1356290745704001537]official description[/url]]
